description:
PROBLEM (root cause, PRINCIPAL-surfaced 2026-06-04). All agents commit with the bare human git identity (e.g. denson / densonsmith2@gmail.com). git + beadwork + agent-identity are ONE system (bw IS git on the orphan beadwork branch), so this breaks attribution everywhere: git blame attributes every line to the human regardless of which seat wrote it; the Co-Authored-By trailer lives in the commit MESSAGE body, which git blame does not read; bw writes are unattributable; the [from:] tags + _the_stoa seat suffixes are a PROSE sub-namespace workaround for the missing real per-agent git identity.

DECIDED DESIGN (with PRINCIPAL 2026-06-04). Give persistent seats a per-seat git SUB-IDENTITY under the human account (a sub-namespace), not separate accounts. The sub-ids ARE the human (same account, mailmap-canonical to the human), so the absolute never-override-Author rule is honored in spirit: Author stays the human, Committer = the seat. Generalizes per human -- each human (Denson, Marianne, Lonnie) gets their own seat sub-ids under their own account.

EMAIL SCHEME (business-portable; NOT plus-addressing). Plus-addressing (human+seat@gmail) is convenience-only and fails on many business/M365 tenants. Use either (1) synthetic non-deliverable emails (seat@scope.local) -- work everywhere for blame/bw/mailmap, do not link to a GitHub account; or (2) real aliases on a domain the human controls (seat@agents.domain) -- give blame AND GitHub-account roll-up on any provider. Decide per deployment; default likely synthetic unless GitHub contribution roll-up is needed. A repo .mailmap maps all seat sub-ids to the canonical human for git blame/log/shortlog roll-up.

THE WORK (three coordinated pieces + two PRINCIPAL requirements):
1. INSTALL -- NEW CASE (PRINCIPAL: we need an install case where we help them set up a git account and then use that identity). Today install.sh (L1287-1308) seeds principal-identity from git config --global on the target, and if unset the gate fail-opens (dormant). NEW REQUIREMENT: when the target has NO git identity, the install must INTERACTIVELY help the human set up a git identity/account, then use it -- do NOT silently go dormant. AND extend the seeding to generate the per-seat sub-ids for that human (current seeding captures only the bare human identity).
2. ACTIVATION (design piece 1) -- each persistent seat activation sets its GIT_COMMITTER_NAME/EMAIL (env beats config, so git uses it automatically) plus a session seat-marker (e.g. STOA_SEAT=PLINY_<human>).
3. GATE (design piece 2) -- extend pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh from a permit-list (is this A recognized PRINCIPAL identity) to permit + REQUIRE-the-session-seat: deny any commit whose committer is not the session declared seat (catches bare-human fallback AND foreign identity).

FAIL-CLOSED (PRINCIPAL: we want a session bricked if it is doing shit we cannot track). The seat-check fails CLOSED: a commit the gate cannot confirm is from a trackable seat identity is DENIED (bricks the commit), reversing the current fail-open for this check. DESIGN DELIBERATELY the distinction: fail-closed on cannot-confirm-trackable-seat (PRINCIPAL intent) vs the gate-internal-error fail mode (current gate fails-open on its OWN bugs to avoid bricking on a gate defect) -- decide whether the internal-error mode also flips. The hook fires ONLY in Claude sessions, so the human direct terminal commits (legitimately bare-human, outside Claude) are unaffected.

SCOPE: persistent cross-session seats (PLINY_<proj>, POLYBIUS_<proj>, user-tier POLYBIUS). One-shot CAPTAINs: decide in design whether they also get seat sub-ids or stay Co-Authored-By trailers.

VERIFY (do NOT assume -- ground-truth / current-docs):
- Does bw route its writes through the gated `git commit` path, or commit via an internal git path that BYPASSES the PreToolUse hook? If bypass, bw attribution + the gate need a different hook point. LOAD-BEARING.
- Confirm git env-var precedence and, for scheme (2), GitHub verified-email account-linking for the chosen provider.
- Confirm fail-closed cannot lock out a legitimately-configured session or the human direct commits.

INTERSECTS: operating-disciplines.md §28 (Co-Authored-By seat-identity convention -- this PROMOTES seat identity from trailer to committer); the absolute never-override-Author rule (preserved: Author = human, Committer = seat); global CLAUDE.md authorship discipline; the existing pretooluse-author-field-audit.sh + .claude/hooks/principal-identity allow-list + install.sh L1287-1308 seeding.

CROSS-REF: u--y3t (bw sync / multi-writer context); the git-blame breakage analysis (2026-06-04 PRINCIPAL session).
title: Agent git sub-identity under the human account + require-via-gate enforcement (fail-closed) + install identity-setup case
